node.title: PMA sigma-one generic defect-four source obstruction
node.statement: At the valid official row (q,n,k)=(65537^2,65536,32768), an exact first-moment argument constructs a maximal source word with more than n^6 primitive post-owner codewords of exact defect four, no background hit, and exactly six singleton petal hits. Odd support size excludes exact periodicity, a balanced core excludes the growing dyadic owner, and a base-valued {x,-x} pair excludes odd lift. Hence Top union Post exceeds n^6 and #Post>B_post, refuting the finite pma_wide_residual allocation without refuting a larger polynomial imgfib theorem.
